content.text: 4-second cinematic live-action Han-period grain warehouse. First-person POV from a grain soldier, two grey-brown coarse sleeves in bottom foreground. A closed unlabelled narrow wooden voucher bundle is held with its plain wood BACK facing camera. 0-1s player moves it toward the empty table. 1-2.5s player places it flat near the grain manager; the manager reaches down to check its tied edge without opening it. 2.5-4s manager nods once after checking, player releases voucher and withdraws both hands, voucher remains on table. One continuous medium close shot shows actual placement contact, hands release and final resting position. Keep the manager same identity as reference. Wooden and textile textures sharp, natural overcast daylight, warehouse bags behind. No opening, no paper, no labels, NO visible writing or Chinese characters, no subtitles, no boxes, no overlays, no blur/mosaic masks, no extra book materialization. No speech, no narrator, no names spoken. Voice whitelist empty. No BGM, background music or score. Only synchronized wood contact, sleeve rustle and quiet warehouse ambience.
